evidence_used: visual inspection of the object showing a standard roll of toilet paper made of soft, fibrous, porous paper tissue
gecko embodiment description stating dry adhesion degrades with porosity, roughness, and interrupted contact
gecko.calculation_summary: no reliable force estimate can be calculated because dry adhesion fails on porous, fibrous tissue
assumptions_and_uncertainty: assumed the paper surface is sufficiently porous and textured to prevent effective van der Waals contact
high uncertainty due to zero-shot vision-only condition without mass or friction measurements
gecko.reasoning_trace: The gecko pad requires smooth, clean, nonporous surfaces to establish intimate contact for dry adhesion. The target object is a soft, porous, fibrous paper tissue roll. Therefore, gecko adhesion is fundamentally incompatible, making the grasp infeasible or requiring maximum force with imminent slip.

evidence_used: visual inspection of the lightweight standard toilet paper roll
silicone embodiment description highlighting high-friction silicone pad useful on rough, porous, or compliant surfaces
silicone.calculation_summary: F_normal estimated based on object weight estimation (~0.15 kg -> ~1.5 N weight) divided by estimated friction coefficient (~0.6) with a safety factor of 1.0 to yield approximately 2.5 N stationary-finger normal force.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: assumed light object weight typical of a standard toilet paper roll
visual approximation of friction and compliance without direct tactile measurements
silicone.reasoning_trace: The silicone gripper relies on friction and viscoelastic compliance rather than dry adhesion. Because the object is lightweight and compressible, moderate normal force allows the fin-ray silicone fingers to conform to the roll surface and securely lift it without crushing or slipping.

comparison_evidence: object surface is made of porous, fibrous paper tissue
gecko adhesion fails on porous or rough surfaces, whereas silicone friction and compliance handle porous textures effectively
recommendation_summary: The silicone gripper is recommended because its high-friction elastomeric pad accommodates the porous, fibrous texture of the paper tissue roll. The gecko gripper is infeasible due to the material's porosity and texture preventing effective dry adhesion.
